saying: Nearly all commenters said the whole conversation or session, not the individual turn, should be the unit of risk assessment, and asked FDA to require adversarial multi-turn trajectory testing (escalation, user pressure, long context, session boundaries).

disagreement.text: No material conflict: commenters converge on trajectory-level assessment. What they debate is how to operationalize it \u2014 how intended use should be written (conversational scope, directiveness ceiling, permitted trajectories), whether to classify by the highest plausible-risk turn, and what acceptance criteria or bounded escape rates should apply.
